feature: SQL: INNER JOIN: Returns all orders

behavior_under_test.description: Test that an inner join from orders to customers returns all 830 orders.
behavior_under_test.sql_sketch: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id;

evidence.span: REQ-SQL-06 An inner join from orders to customers shall return all 830 orders, because no order has a NULL customer.

feature: SQL: INNER JOIN: Returning all orders

behavior_under_test.description: Test that the SQL query returns the company_name for each customer with at least one order.
behavior_under_test.sql_sketch: SELECT customers.customer_id, customers.company_name, COUNT(orders.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers INNER JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.customer_id, customers.company_name
behavior_under_test.property: The result set contains the correct company_name for each customer with at least one order.

assertions: The result set contains rows for each customer with at least one order.
Each row contains the correct company_name for the customer.
The order_count is the number of orders for the customer.

evidence.span: The lookup returns customer_id, company_name, and order_count for each selected customer.
An order belongs to a customer only when orders.customer_id equals customers.customer_id.
